annotations.title: Send a suggestion or bug report

description:
Use this when the user wants to tell the RipClip team something: "I have an idea for RipClip", "suggest a
        feature", "report a bug", "this export failed, tell them". kind: suggestion (an idea; the first line is its
        title) or bug (what happened; say what they did and what they saw). text: the user's own words, up to 4000
        characters; write nothing the user did not say. It goes to the team's reviewing inbox like the Suggestions and
        Bug report forms in RipClip, with the same limits (5 of each a day, 20 waiting at once). The app says: if we
        build a suggestion 300 credits are added, and 150 for a real bug we fix; the team decides, nothing is promised.
        Not for: help with using RipClip, or a problem with one job (job_status). Free: no Horizon Units.
name: send_feedback
title: Send a suggestion or bug report
